cases.study_information: All molecules are the VHH-Fc constructs listed in Table9; sequence1 contains the complete tested fusion chain. Molecular names have been anonymized. The row reference is a measured reference and is not a target. All eight other rows must be predicted. The source dsDNA ELISA coats1ug/mL dsDNA overnight at4C, blocks withPBS+0.5%BSA, applies100nM VHH-Fc atroom temperature for1h, detects anti-humanIgG-HRP and reads450nm. Score is normalized absorbance relative to no-antibody control wells; higher scores indicate stronger nonspecific DNA binding.
